_note: Chat provider for the floating 'Talk to Sofía / Habla con Sofía' button. "native" = in-page Sofía widget (contact-widget.js + dialog). "ghl" = GoHighLevel/LeadConnector chat widget, loaded only on the first click (ghl-chat.js). Revert the trial by setting provider to "native". Widget colors/texts are set in the GHL dashboard; ghl-chat.js overrides the colors to the site palette. See CONTACT-WIDGET.md.
